$comment: The trader's wares. Coins come in by the sackful and there is little to spend them on; these are the things the hill will take coins for. Prices are tuning, not law: scripts/tune-trader.ts prints each as hours of work. The ferryman is not a ware — he charges at the crossing, twice what the thing is worth, and an obol settles it.

name: A Lamp
line: Twelve hours of night become sixteen. The hill does not notice.

name: Oil for the Lamp
line: Twenty hours. It smells of fish, because it is.

name: A Long Wick
line: A whole day, lit. Nobody has asked for more.

name: A Second Look
line: You start checking the ground twice. Twice the capes, the same ground.

name: Release from the Oath
line: The gods let go, for a price. It doubles each time; they remember.
